comments.html:
I really enjoy your comics. I see you’ve gotten back in the habit of making them regularly in the past month or so. I’m very grateful for that.

Have you ever considered making a patreon for yourself or selling posters of your comic? I have one of your comics (Eat Shit and Die 202) hanging on the wall in my room as a poster, which I’d have rather bought from you than gotten via an office supplies store.
